title: Museum London

services.name: Art Tours
services.desc: A school visit to Museum London offers students a hands-on, curriculum-connected experience. Led by expert guides and staff, programs explore Canadian art and regional history through exhibitions and artifacts, sparking curiosity and creativity in an interactive setting designed to inspire learners at every grade level. Booking requests must be submitted through our online form. Once received, our staff will be in touch to confirm your visit. Museum London offers curriculum-connected tours for Kindergarten to Grade 12. Led by experienced guides, students engage directly with original artworks and exhibitions to deepen their understanding of art and design through dynamic, inquiry-based
